notes: «قال سئلت عن المتلاعنين» is Said's first-person account; the person who asked him is unnamed and does not transmit, so no link
«فأتيت عبد الله بن عمر» — the one asked and answering (Ibn Umar) is a link in his own place (rule 6)
«ثم ذكر بمثل حديث ابن نمير» refers to another route (not written here): a reference, not stored
